reuse.why: One assertion plus a wrapper applied at registration covers all five link handlers without touching their bodies; the existing accounts/link.ts module for link helpers is not used to host it.

duplication.why: The holder query and error exist once; each registration only supplies its provider and how to read the external account id.

placement.why: Applying the guard at the app.method registration layer is sound, but the assertion would sit more naturally in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank.

scope.why: Adds only the guard, its wiring and a dedicated test file.

maintainability.why: Central and easy to extend to a new provider; the check living in a registration wrapper means calling a link function directly would skip it, which a maintainer must know.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link methods are registered through withBankAccountLinkCheck.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked applied via withBankAccountLinkCheck to every '*-accounts-link' method in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts.
